1: ---
2: description: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.
3: alwaysApply: true
4: ---
5: 
6: # Karpathy behavioral guidelines
7: 
8: Behavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes. Merge with project-specific instructions as needed.
9: 
10: **Tradeoff:** These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks, use judgment.
11: 
12: ## 1. Think Before Coding
13: 
14: **Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.**
15: 
16: Before implementing:
17: 
18: - State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.
19: - If multiple interpretations exist, present them - don't pick silently.
20: - If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.
21: - If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.
22: 
23: ## 2. Simplicity First
24: 
25: **Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.**
26: 
27: - No features beyond what was asked.
28: - No abstractions for single-use code.
29: - No "flexibility" or "configurability" that wasn't requested.
30: - No error handling for impossible scenarios.
31: - If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.
32: 
33: Ask yourself: "Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated?" If yes, simplify.
34: 
35: ## 3. Surgical Changes
36: 
37: **Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.**
38: 
39: When editing existing code:
40: 
41: - Don't "improve" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.
42: - Don't refactor things that aren't broken.
43: - Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.
44: - If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it - don't delete it.
45: 
46: When your changes create orphans:
47: 
48: - Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.
49: - Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked.
50: 
51: The test: Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.
52: 
53: ## 4. Goal-Driven Execution
54: 
55: **Define success criteria. Loop until verified.**
56: 
57: Transform tasks into verifiable goals:
58: 
59: - "Add validation" → "Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass"
60: - "Fix the bug" → "Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass"
61: - "Refactor X" → "Ensure tests pass before and after"
62: 
63: For multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:
64: 
65: ```
66: 1. [Step] → verify: [check]
67: 2. [Step] → verify: [check]
68: 3. [Step] → verify: [check]
69: ```
70: 
71: Strong success criteria let you loop independently. Weak criteria ("make it work") require constant clarification.
72: 
73: ---
74: 
75: **These guidelines are working if:** fewer unnecessary changes in diffs, fewer rewrites due to overcomplication, and clarifying questions come before implementation rather than after mistakes.

(End of file - total 75 lines)
</content>

1: ---
2: description: Ponytail, lazy senior dev mode. Always pick the simplest solution that works.
3: globs:
4: alwaysApply: true
5: ---
6: 
7: # Ponytail, lazy senior dev mode
8: 
9: You are a lazy senior developer. Lazy means efficient, not careless. The best code is the code never written.
10: 
11: Before writing any code, stop at the first rung that holds:
12: 
13: 1. Does this need to be built at all? (YAGNI)
14: 2. Does it already exist in this codebase? Reuse the helper, util, or pattern that's already here, don't re-write it.
15: 3. Does the standard library already do this? Use it.
16: 4. Does a native platform feature cover it? Use it.
17: 5. Does an already-installed dependency solve it? Use it.
18: 6. Can this be one line? Make it one line.
19: 7. Only then: write the minimum code that works.
20: 
21: The ladder runs after you understand the problem, not instead of it: read the task and the code it touches, trace the real flow end to end, then climb.
22: 
23: Bug fix = root cause, not symptom: a report names a symptom. Grep every caller of the function you touch and fix the shared function once — one guard there is a smaller diff than one per caller, and patching only the path the ticket names leaves a sibling caller still broken.
24: 
25: Rules:
26: 
27: - No abstractions that weren't explicitly requested.
28: - No new dependency if it can be avoided.
29: - No boilerplate nobody asked for.
30: - Deletion over addition. Boring over clever. Fewest files possible.
31: - Shortest working diff wins, but only once you understand the problem. The smallest change in the wrong place isn't lazy, it's a second bug.
32: - Question complex requests: "Do you actually need X, or does Y cover it?"
33: - Pick the edge-case-correct option when two stdlib approaches are the same size, lazy means less code, not the flimsier algorithm.
34: - Mark deliberate simplifications that cut a real corner with a known ceiling (global lock, O(n²) scan, naive heuristic) with a `ponytail:` comment naming the ceiling and upgrade path.
35: 
36: Not lazy about: understanding the problem (read it fully and trace the real flow before picking a rung, a small diff you don't understand is just laziness dressed up as efficiency), input validation at trust boundaries, error handling that prevents data loss, security, accessibility, the calibration real hardware needs (the platform is never the spec ideal, a clock drifts, a sensor reads off), anything explicitly requested. Lazy code without its check is unfinished: non-trivial logic leaves ONE runnable check behind, the smallest thing that fails if the logic breaks (an assert-based demo/self-check or one small test file; no frameworks, no fixtures). Trivial one-liners need no test.

(End of file - total 36 lines)
</content>

51: +---

55: +kind_display_name: ALE OmniSwitch vAOS
56: +---
57: +# Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS
58: +
59: +[ALE OmniSwitch](https://www.al-enterprise.com/en/products/switches) virtual AOS (vAOS) 8.x is identified with the `ale_vaos` kind in the [topology file](../topo-def-file.md). It is built using the [vrnetlab](../vrnetlab.md) project and essentially is a QEMU VM packaged in a docker container format.
60: +
61: +## Getting the image
62: +
63: +To get the vAOS image, contact your ALE representative or ask for it on the [Spacewalkers community](https://www.spacewalkers.com/).
64: +
65: +## Managing ale_vaos nodes
66: +
67: +!!!note
68: +    Containers with vAOS inside take about 3 minutes to boot and apply their configuration.
69: +    You can monitor the progress with `docker logs -f <container-name>`. The node becomes healthy once the bootstrap is done.
70: +
71: +=== "SSH"
72: +    `ssh admin@<container-name>`
73: +    Password: `Switch@123`
74: +=== "Serial console"
75: +    `telnet <container-name> 5000`
76: +
77: +## Interface naming
78: +
79: +| Container interface | vAOS port |
80: +| ------------------- | --------- |
81: +| `eth1` to `eth10`   | `1/1/1` to `1/1/10` |
82: +| `eth11`             | `1/1/29A` |
83: +| `eth12`             | `1/1/30A` |
84: +
85: +In the topology, ports `1/1/1` to `1/1/10` can be used directly, for example `os1:1/1/1`. Ports 1/1/29A and 1/1/30A are addressed as `eth11` and `eth12`.
86: +
87: +The management interface is the EMP port. With `CLAB_MGMT_PASSTHROUGH: "true"` the EMP port gets the node management address and is bridged to the containerlab management network.
88: +
89: +## Features and options
90: +
91: +### Node configuration
92: +
93: +Once the switch has booted, the vrnetlab launcher logs in on the serial console, sets the system name and prompt to the node name, configures the EMP address and saves the configuration.
94: +
95: +### Startup configuration
96: +
97: +The [`startup-config`](../nodes.md#startup-config) file is pushed line by line on the serial console after the EMP address is configured, then saved with `write memory flash-synchro`. Use the AOS CLI format of `vcboot.cfg` or `show configuration snapshot`: one command per line, lines starting with `!` are skipped.
98: +
99: +```yaml
100: +topology:
101: +  nodes:
102: +    os1:
103: +      kind: ale_vaos
104: +      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01
105: +      startup-config: os1.cfg
106: +```
107: +
108: +### Environment variables
109: +
110: +| Variable          | Description |
111: +| ----------------- | ----------- |
112: +| `EMP_ROUTES`      | Static routes on EMP, `prefix=gateway` separated by commas. A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is skipped. |
113: +| `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS` | Extra CLI commands, separated by `;` |
114: +| `VAOS_SAVE`       | `false` skips `write memory flash-synchro` |
115: +| `VAOS_BOOTSTRAP`  | `false` skips the console bootstrap |
116: +
117: +### Saving the configuration
118: +
119: +`containerlab save` runs `write memory flash-synchro` on each vAOS node and stores the output of `show configuration snapshot` in `clab-<lab_name>/<node_name>/config/startup-config.cfg`.
120: +
121: +## Known issues and limitations
122: +
123: +- The node credentials must match an account of the vAOS image (default `admin` / `Switch@123`): they are used by the launcher to log in on the console.
124: +- `containerlab save` uses the serial console: close any open console session on the node before saving.

162: @@ -0,0 +1,167 @@
163: +package vr_vaos
164: +
165: +import (
166: +	"context"
167: +	"fmt"
168: +	"os"
169: +	"path"
170: +	"path/filepath"
171: +	"regexp"
172: +	"strings"
173: +	"time"
174: +
175: +	"github.com/charmbracelet/log"
176: +	clabnodes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/nodes"
177: +	clabtypes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/types"
178: +	clabutils "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/utils"
179: +)
180: +
181: +var (
182: +	kindNames = []string{"ale_vaos"}
183: +	// defaultCredentials are the default credentials of the vAOS image.
184: +	defaultCredentials = clabnodes.NewCredentials("admin", "Switch@123")
185: +
186: +	// InterfaceRegexp maps front-panel ports 1/1/1 to 1/1/10 to eth1 to eth10.
187: +	// 1/1/29A and 1/1/30A are only addressable as eth11 and eth12.
188: +	InterfaceRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(`^1/1/(?P<port>[1-9]|10)$`)
189: +	InterfaceOffset = 1
190: +	InterfaceHelp   = "1/1/X (where 1 <= X <= 10) or ethX (where 1 <= X <= 12)"
191: +)
192: +
193: +const (
194: +	// scrapliPlatformName is empty: the vrnetlab launcher handles containerlab save.
195: +	scrapliPlatformName = ""
196: +
197: +	// containerlab save handshake with the vrnetlab launcher, through the
198: +	// config dir mounted at /config in the container.
199: +	saveRequestFile = ".vaos-save-request"
200: +	saveDoneFile    = ".vaos-save-done"
201: +	saveTimeout     = 5 * time.Minute
202: +	savePollPeriod  = time.Second
203: +)
204: +
205: +// Register registers the node in the NodeRegistry.
206: +func Register(r *clabnodes.NodeRegistry) {
207: +	platformAttrs := &clabnodes.PlatformAttrs{
208: +		ScrapliPlatformName: scrapliPlatformName,
209: +	}
210: +
211: +	nrea := clabnodes.NewNodeRegistryEntryAttributes(defaultCredentials, nil, platformAttrs)
212: +
213: +	r.Register(kindNames, func() clabnodes.Node {
214: +		return new(vrVAOS)
215: +	}, nrea)
216: +}
217: +
218: +type vrVAOS struct {
219: +	clabnodes.VRNode
220: +}
221: +
222: +func (n *vrVAOS) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...clabnodes.NodeOption) error {
223: +	// Init VRNode
224: +	n.VRNode = *clabnodes.NewVRNode(n, defaultCredentials, scrapliPlatformName)
225: +	// set virtualization requirement
226: +	n.HostRequirements.VirtRequired = true
227: +
228: +	n.Cfg = cfg
229: +	for _, o := range opts {
230: +		o(n)
231: +	}
232: +	// env vars are used to set launch.py arguments in vrnetlab container
233: +	defEnv := map[string]string{
234: +		"CONNECTION_MODE":    clabnodes.VrDefConnMode,
235: +		"USERNAME":           n.Cfg.Credentials.Username,
236: +		"PASSWORD":           n.Cfg.Credentials.Password,
237: +		"DOCKER_NET_V4_ADDR": n.Mgmt.IPv4Subnet,
238: +		"DOCKER_NET_V6_ADDR": n.Mgmt.IPv6Subnet,
239: +	}
240: +	n.Cfg.Env = clabutils.MergeStringMaps(defEnv, n.Cfg.Env)
241: +
242: +	// mount config dir to support startup-config functionality
243: +	// (the startup-config is copied to /config/startup-config.cfg and pushed
244: +	// on the console by launch.py once the switch has booted)
245: +	n.Cfg.Binds = append(
246: +		n.Cfg.Binds,
247: +		fmt.Sprint(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.ConfigDirName), ":/config"),
248: +	)
249: +
250: +	if n.Cfg.Env["CONNECTION_MODE"] == "macvtap" {
251: +		// mount dev dir to enable macvtap
252: +		n.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, "/dev:/dev")
253: +	}
254: +
255: +	n.Cfg.Cmd = fmt.Sprintf(
256: +		"--username %s --password %s --hostname %s --connection-mode %s --trace",
257: +		n.Cfg.Env["USERNAME"],
258: +		n.Cfg.Env["PASSWORD"],
259: +		n.Cfg.ShortName,
260: +		n.Cfg.Env["CONNECTION_MODE"],
261: +	)
262: +
263: +	n.InterfaceRegexp = InterfaceRegexp
264: +	n.InterfaceOffset = InterfaceOffset
265: +	n.InterfaceHelp = InterfaceHelp
266: +
267: +	return nil
268: +}
269: +
270: +// SaveConfig asks the vrnetlab launcher to save the configuration. The launcher
271: +// runs "write memory flash-synchro" on the serial console, writes the output of
272: +// "show configuration snapshot" to the startup-config file of the node, then
273: +// writes "ok" or the error in the done file.
274: +func (n *vrVAOS) SaveConfig(ctx context.Context) (*clabnodes.SaveConfigResult, error) {
275: +	cfgDir := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.ConfigDirName)
276: +	reqFile := filepath.Join(cfgDir, saveRequestFile)
277: +	doneFile := filepath.Join(cfgDir, saveDoneFile)
278: +
279: +	_ = os.Remove(doneFile)
280: +
281: +	err := os.WriteFile(reqFile, []byte("save\n"), 0o644)
282: +	if err != nil {
283: +		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: failed to request configuration save: %w",
284: +			n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
285: +	}
286: +
287: +	msg, err := waitSaveDone(ctx, doneFile, saveTimeout)
288: +	if err != nil {
289: +		_ = os.Remove(reqFile)
290: +
291: +		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
292: +	}
293: +
294: +	if msg != "ok" {
295: +		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: configuration save failed: %s", n.Cfg.ShortName, msg)
296: +	}
297: +
298: +	configPath := filepath.Join(cfgDir, n.StartupCfgFName)
299: +	log.Info("Saved configuration to path", "nodeName", n.Cfg.ShortName, "path", configPath)
300: +
301: +	return &clabnodes.SaveConfigResult{
302: +		ConfigPath: configPath,
303: +	}, nil
304: +}
305: +
306: +// waitSaveDone waits for the launcher to write its result in doneFile and
307: +// returns it. An empty file is still being written and is read again.
308: +func waitSaveDone(ctx context.Context, doneFile string, timeout time.Duration) (string, error) {
309: +	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
310: +
311: +	for {
312: +		b, err := os.ReadFile(doneFile)
313: +		if msg := strings.TrimSpace(string(b)); err == nil && msg != "" {
314: +			_ = os.Remove(doneFile)
315: +
316: +			return msg, nil
317: +		}
318: +
319: +		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
320: +			return "", fmt.Errorf("timeout waiting for the configuration save")
321: +		}
322: +
323: +		select {
324: +		case <-ctx.Done():
325: +			return "", ctx.Err()
326: +		case <-time.After(savePollPeriod):
327: +		}
328: +	}
329: +}

442: +				break
443: +			}
444: +

446: +		}
447: +

450: +		_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(cfgDir, saveDoneFile), nil, 0o644)
451: +

453: +
454: +		_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(cfgDir, saveDoneFile), []byte(result+"\n"), 0o644)
455: +	}()
456: +}

OmniSwitch](https://www.al-enterprise.com/en/products/switches) virtual AOS (vAOS) 8.x is identified with the `ale_vaos` kind in the [topology file](../topo-def-file.md). It is built using the [vrnetlab](../vrnetlab.md) project and essentially is a QEMU VM packaged in a docker container format.\n60: +\n61: +## Getting the image\n62: +\n63: +To get the vAOS image, contact your ALE representative or ask for it on the [Spacewalkers community](https://www.spacewalkers.com/).\n64: +\n65: +## Managing ale_vaos nodes\n66: +\n67: +!!!note\n68: +    Containers with vAOS inside take about 3 minutes to boot and apply their configuration.\n69: +    You can monitor the progress with `docker logs -f <container-name>`. The node becomes healthy once the bootstrap is done.\n70: +\n71: +=== \"SSH\"\n72: +    `ssh admin@<container-name>`\n73: +    Password: `Switch@123`\n74: +=== \"Serial console\"\n75: +    `telnet <container-name> 5000`\n76: +\n77: +## Interface naming\n78: +\n79: +| Container interface | vAOS port |\n80: +| ------------------- | --------- |\n81: +| `eth1` to `eth10`   | `1/1/1` to `1/1/10` |\n82: +| `eth11`             | `1/1/29A` |\n83: +| `eth12`             | `1/1/30A` |\n84: +\n85: +In the topology, ports `1/1/1` to `1/1/10` can be used directly, for example `os1:1/1/1`. Ports 1/1/29A and 1/1/30A are addressed as `eth11` and `eth12`.\n86: +\n87: +The management interface is the EMP port. With `CLAB_MGMT_PASSTHROUGH: \"true\"` the EMP port gets the node management address and is bridged to the containerlab management network.\n88: +\n89: +## Features and options\n90: +\n91: +### Node configuration\n92: +\n93: +Once the switch has booted, the vrnetlab launcher logs in on the serial console, sets the system name and prompt to the node name, configures the EMP address and saves the configuration.\n94: +\n95: +### Startup configuration\n96: +\n97: +The [`startup-config`](../nodes.md#startup-config) file is pushed line by line on the serial console after the EMP address is configured, then saved with `write memory flash-synchro`. Use the AOS CLI format of `vcboot.cfg` or `show configuration snapshot`: one command per line, lines starting with `!` are skipped.\n98: +\n99: +```yaml\n100: +topology:\n101: +  nodes:\n102: +    os1:\n103: +      kind: ale_vaos\n104: +      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01\n105: +      startup-config: os1.cfg\n106: +```\n107: +\n108: +### Environment variables\n109: +\n110: +| Variable          | Description |\n111: +| ----------------- | ----------- |\n112: +| `EMP_ROUTES`      | Static routes on EMP, `prefix=gateway` separated by commas. A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is skipped. |\n113: +| `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS` | Extra CLI commands, separated by `;` |\n114: +| `VAOS_SAVE`       | `false` skips `write memory flash-synchro` |\n115: +| `VAOS_BOOTSTRAP`  | `false` skips the console bootstrap |\n116: +\n117: +### Saving the configuration\n118: +\n119: +`containerlab save` runs `write memory flash-synchro` on each vAOS node and stores the output of `show configuration snapshot` in `clab-<lab_name>/<node_name>/config/startup-config.cfg`.\n120: +\n121: +## Known issues and limitations\n122: +\n123: +- The node credentials must match an account of the vAOS image (default `admin` / `Switch@123`): they are used by the launcher to log in on the console.\n124: +- `containerlab save` uses the serial console: os.Remove(doneFile)\n315: +\n316: +\t\t\treturn msg, nil\n317: +\t\t}\n318: +\n319: +\t\tif time.Now().After(deadline) {\n320: +\t\t\treturn \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"timeout waiting for the configuration boost: 4\n+kind_code_name: ale_vaos\n+kind_display_name: ALE OmniSwitch vAOS\n+---\n+# Alcatel-Lucent Enterprise OmniSwitch vAOS\n+\n+[ALE OmniSwitch](https://www.al-enterprise.com/en/products/switches) virtual AOS (vAOS) 8.x is identified with the `ale_vaos` kind in the [topology file](../topo-def-file.md). It is built using the [vrnetlab](../vrnetlab.md) project and essentially is a QEMU VM packaged in a docker container format.\n+\n+## Getting the image\n+\n+To get the vAOS image, contact your ALE representative or ask for it on the [Spacewalkers community](https://www.spacewalkers.com/).\n+\n+## Managing ale_vaos nodes\n+\n+!!!note\n+    Containers with vAOS inside take about 3 minutes to boot and apply their configuration.\n+    You can monitor the progress with `docker logs -f <container-name>`. The node becomes healthy once the bootstrap is done.\n+\n+=== \"SSH\"\n+    `ssh admin@<container-name>`\n+    Password: `Switch@123`\n+=== \"Serial console\"\n+    `telnet <container-name> 5000`\n+\n+## Interface naming\n+\n+| Container interface | vAOS port |\n+| ------------------- | --------- |\n+| `eth1` to `eth10`   | `1/1/1` to `1/1/10` |\n+| `eth11`             | `1/1/29A` |\n+| `eth12`             | `1/1/30A` |\n+\n+In the topology, ports `1/1/1` to `1/1/10` can be used directly, for example `os1:1/1/1`. Ports 1/1/29A and 1/1/30A are addressed as `eth11` and `eth12`.\n+\n+The management interface is the EMP port. With `CLAB_MGMT_PASSTHROUGH: \"true\"` the EMP port gets the node management address and is bridged to the containerlab management network.\n+\n+## Features and options\n+\n+### Node configuration\n+\n+Once the switch has booted, the vrnetlab launcher logs in on the serial console, sets the system name and prompt to the node name, configures the EMP address and saves the configuration.\n+\n+### Startup configuration\n+\n+The [`startup-config`](../nodes.md#startup-config) file is pushed line by line on the serial console after the EMP address is configured, then saved with `write memory flash-synchro`. Use the AOS CLI format of `vcboot.cfg` or `show configuration snapshot`: one command per line, lines starting with `!` are skipped.\n+\n+```yaml\n+topology:\n+  nodes:\n+    os1:\n+      kind: ale_vaos\n+      image: vrnetlab/ale_vaos:8.11.162.R01\n+      startup-config: os1.cfg\n+```\n+\n+### Environment variables\n+\n+| Variable          | Description |\n+| ----------------- | ----------- |\n+| `EMP_ROUTES`      | Static routes on EMP, `prefix=gateway` separated by commas. A default route (0.0.0.0/0) is not allowed on EMP and is skipped. |\n+| `VAOS_EXTRA_CMDS` | Extra CLI commands, separated by `;` |\n+| `VAOS_SAVE`       | `false` skips `write memory flash-synchro` |\n+| `VAOS_BOOTSTRAP`  | `false` skips the console bootstrap |\n+\n+### Saving the configuration\n+\n+`containerlab save` runs `write memory flash-synchro` on each vAOS node and stores the output of `show configuration snapshot` in `clab-<lab_name>/<node_name>/config/startup-config.cfg`.\n+\n+## Known issues and limitations\n+\n+- The node credentials must match an account of the vAOS image (default `admin` / `Switch@123`): they are used by the launcher to log in on the console.\n+- `containerlab save` uses the serial console: close any open console session on the node before saving.\ndiff --git a/docs/manual/vrnetlab.md b/docs/manual/vrnetlab.md\nindex ae4577b..31401c0 100644\n--- a/docs/manual/vrnetlab.md\n+++ b/docs/manual/vrnetlab.md\n@@ -116,10 +116,11 @@ The images 1: package vr_vaos
2: 
3: import (
4: 	"context"
5: 	"fmt"
6: 	"os"
7: 	"path"
8: 	"path/filepath"
9: 	"regexp"
10: 	"strings"
11: 	"time"
12: 
13: 	"github.com/charmbracelet/log"
14: 	clabnodes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/nodes"
15: 	clabtypes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/types"
16: 	clabutils "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/utils"
17: )
18: 
19: var (
20: 	kindNames = []string{"ale_vaos"}
21: 	// defaultCredentials are the default credentials of the vAOS image.
22: 	defaultCredentials = clabnodes.NewCredentials("admin", "Switch@123")
23: 
24: 	// InterfaceRegexp maps front-panel ports 1/1/1 to 1/1/10 to eth1 to eth10.
25: 	// 1/1/29A and 1/1/30A are only addressable as eth11 and eth12.
26: 	InterfaceRegexp = regexp.MustCompile(`^1/1/(?P<port>[1-9]|10)$`)
27: 	InterfaceOffset = 1
28: 	InterfaceHelp   = "1/1/X (where 1 <= X <= 10) or ethX (where 1 <= X <= 12)"
29: )
30: 
31: const (
32: 	// scrapliPlatformName is empty: the vrnetlab launcher handles containerlab save.
33: 	scrapliPlatformName = ""
34: 
35: 	// containerlab save handshake with the vrnetlab launcher, through the
36: 	// config dir mounted at /config in the container.
37: 	saveRequestFile = ".vaos-save-request"
38: 	saveDoneFile    = ".vaos-save-done"
39: 	saveTimeout     = 5 * time.Minute
40: 	savePollPeriod  = time.Second
41: )
42: 
43: // Register registers the node in the NodeRegistry.
44: func Register(r *clabnodes.NodeRegistry) {
45: 	platformAttrs := &clabnodes.PlatformAttrs{
46: 		ScrapliPlatformName: scrapliPlatformName,
47: 	}
48: 
49: 	nrea := clabnodes.NewNodeRegistryEntryAttributes(defaultCredentials, nil, platformAttrs)
50: 
51: 	r.Register(kindNames, func() clabnodes.Node {
52: 		return new(vrVAOS)
53: 	}, nrea)
54: }
55: 
56: type vrVAOS struct {
57: 	clabnodes.VRNode
58: }
59: 
60: func (n *vrVAOS) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...clabnodes.NodeOption) error {
61: 	// Init VRNode
62: 	n.VRNode = *clabnodes.NewVRNode(n, defaultCredentials, scrapliPlatformName)
63: 	// set virtualization requirement
64: 	n.HostRequirements.VirtRequired = true
65: 
66: 	n.Cfg = cfg
67: 	for _, o := range opts {
68: 		o(n)
69: 	}
70: 	// env vars are used to set launch.py arguments in vrnetlab container
71: 	defEnv := map[string]string{
72: 		"CONNECTION_MODE":    clabnodes.VrDefConnMode,
73: 		"USERNAME":           n.Cfg.Credentials.Username,
74: 		"PASSWORD":           n.Cfg.Credentials.Password,
75: 		"DOCKER_NET_V4_ADDR": n.Mgmt.IPv4Subnet,
76: 		"DOCKER_NET_V6_ADDR": n.Mgmt.IPv6Subnet,
77: 	}
78: 	n.Cfg.Env = clabutils.MergeStringMaps(defEnv, n.Cfg.Env)
79: 
80: 	// mount config dir to support startup-config functionality
81: 	// (the startup-config is copied to /config/startup-config.cfg and pushed
82: 	// on the console by launch.py once the switch has booted)
83: 	n.Cfg.Binds = append(
84: 		n.Cfg.Binds,
85: 		fmt.Sprint(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.ConfigDirName), ":/config"),
86: 	)
87: 
88: 	if n.Cfg.Env["CONNECTION_MODE"] == "macvtap" {
89: 		// mount dev dir to enable macvtap
90: 		n.Cfg.Binds = append(n.Cfg.Binds, "/dev:/dev")
91: 	}
92: 
93: 	n.Cfg.Cmd = fmt.Sprintf(
94: 		"--username %s --password %s --hostname %s --connection-mode %s --trace",
95: 		n.Cfg.Env["USERNAME"],
96: 		n.Cfg.Env["PASSWORD"],
97: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
98: 		n.Cfg.Env["CONNECTION_MODE"],
99: 	)
100: 
101: 	n.InterfaceRegexp = InterfaceRegexp
102: 	n.InterfaceOffset = InterfaceOffset
103: 	n.InterfaceHelp = InterfaceHelp
104: 
105: 	return nil
106: }
107: 
108: // SaveConfig asks the vrnetlab launcher to save the configuration. The launcher
109: // runs "write memory flash-synchro" on the serial console, writes the output of
110: // "show configuration snapshot" to the startup-config file of the node, then
111: // writes "ok" or the error in the done file.
112: func (n *vrVAOS) SaveConfig(ctx context.Context) (*clabnodes.SaveConfigResult, error) {
113: 	cfgDir := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.ConfigDirName)
114: 	reqFile := filepath.Join(cfgDir, saveRequestFile)
115: 	doneFile := filepath.Join(cfgDir, saveDoneFile)
116: 
117: 	_ = os.Remove(doneFile)
118: 
119: 	err := os.WriteFile(reqFile, []byte("save\n"), 0o644)
120: 	if err != nil {
121: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: failed to request configuration save: %w",
122: 			n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
123: 	}
124: 
125: 	msg, err := waitSaveDone(ctx, doneFile, saveTimeout)
126: 	if err != nil {
127: 		_ = os.Remove(reqFile)
128: 
129: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %w", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
130: 	}
131: 
132: 	if msg != "ok" {
133: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: configuration save failed: %s", n.Cfg.ShortName, msg)
134: 	}
135: 
136: 	configPath := filepath.Join(cfgDir, n.StartupCfgFName)
137: 	log.Info("Saved configuration to path", "nodeName", n.Cfg.ShortName, "path", configPath)
138: 
139: 	return &clabnodes.SaveConfigResult{
140: 		ConfigPath: configPath,
141: 	}, nil
142: }
143: 
144: // waitSaveDone waits for the launcher to write its result in doneFile and
145: // returns it. An empty file is still being written and is read again.
146: func waitSaveDone(ctx context.Context, doneFile string, timeout time.Duration) (string, error) {
147: 	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
148: 
149: 	for {
150: 		b, err := os.ReadFile(doneFile)
151: 		if msg := strings.TrimSpace(string(b)); err == nil && msg != "" {
152: 			_ = os.Remove(doneFile)
153: 
154: 			return msg, nil
155: 		}
156: 
157: 		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
158: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("timeout waiting for the configuration save")
159: 		}
160: 
161: 		select {
162: 		case <-ctx.Done():
163: 			return "", ctx.Err()
164: 		case <-time.After(savePollPeriod):
165: 		}
166: 	}
167: }

        "text": "package vr_vaos\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\tclablinks \"github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/links\"\n\tclabnodes \"github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/nodes\"\n\tclabtypes \"github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/types\"\n)\n\nfunc newTestNode(t *testing.T) *vrVAOS {\n\tt.Helper()\n\n\tn := &vrVAOS{\n\t\tVRNode: clabnodes.VRNode{\n\t\t\tDefaultNode: clabnodes.DefaultNode{\n\t\t\t\tCfg: &clabtypes.NodeConfig{\n\t\t\t\t\tShortName: \"vaos\",\n\t\t\t\t\tLabDir:    t.TempDir(),\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t\tInterfaceRegexp: InterfaceRegexp,\n\t\t\t\tInterfaceOffset: InterfaceOffset,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t\tConfigDirName:   \"config\",\n\t\t\tStartupCfgFName: \"startup-config.cfg\",\n\t\t},\n\t}\n\tn.OverwriteNode = n\n\tn.InterfaceMappedPrefix = \"eth\"\n\tn.FirstDataIfIndex = 1\n\n\treturn n\n}\n\nfunc TestVAOSInterfaceParsing(t *testing.T) {\n\ttests := map[string]struct {\n\t\tifaces  []string\n\t\twant    []string\n\t\twantErr bool\n\t}{\n\t\t\"alias-parse\": {\n\t\t\tifaces: []string{\"1/1/1\", \"1/1/3\", \"1/1/10\"},\n\t\t\twant:   []string{\"eth1\", \"eth3\", \"eth10\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\t\"original-parse\": {\n\t\t\tifaces: []string{\"eth2\", \"eth11\", \"eth12\"},\n\t\t\twant:   []string{\"eth2\", \"eth11\", \"eth12\"},\n\t\t},\n\t\t\"alias-out-of-range\": {\n\t\t\tifaces:  []string{\"1/1/11\"},\n\t\t\twantErr: true,\n\t\t},\n\t}\n\n\tfor name, tc := range tests {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tn := newTestNode(t)\n\n\t\t\tvar err error\n\n\t\t\tfor _, iface := range tc.ifaces {\n\t\t\t\tep := &clablinks.EndpointVeth{\n\t\t\t\t\tEndpointGeneric: clablinks.EndpointGeneric{IfaceName: iface},\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tif err = n.AddEndpoint(ep); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif err == nil {\n\t\t\t\terr = n.CheckInterfaceName()\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif tc.wantErr {\n\t\t\t\tif err == nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected an error for %v\", tc.ifaces)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tfor idx, ep := range n.Endpoints {\n\t\t\t\tif ep.GetIfaceName() != tc.want[idx] {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"got %q, want %q\", ep.GetIfaceName(), tc.want[idx])\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\n// fakeLauncher answers a save request the way launch.py does.\nfunc fakeLauncher(t *testing.T, cfgDir, result string) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\n\tgo func() {\n\t\treq := filepath.Join(cfgDir, saveRequestFile)\n\t\tfor {\n\t\t\tif _, err := os.Stat(req); err == nil {\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\ttime.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t_ = os.Remove(req)\n\t\t// the done file exists, empty, before the result is written\n\t\t_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(cfgDir, saveDoneFile), nil, 0o644)\n\n\t\ttime.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)\n\n\t\t_ = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(cfgDir, saveDoneFile), []byte(result+\"\\n\"), 0o644)\n\t}()\n}\n\nfunc TestVAOSSaveConfig(t *testing.T) {\n\ttests := map[string]struct {\n\t\tresult  string\n\t\twantErr bool\n\t}{\n\t\t\"ok\":    {result: \"ok\"},\n\t\t\"error\": {result: \"error: could not log in on the console\", wantErr: true},\n\t}\n\n\tfor name, tc := range tests {\n\t\tt.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\tn := newTestNode(t)\n\n\t\t\tcfgDir := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.ConfigDirName)\n\t\t\tif err := os.MkdirAll(cfgDir, 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tfakeLauncher(t, cfgDir, tc.result)\n\n\t\t\tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)\n\t\t\tdefer cancel()\n\n\t\t\tres, err := n.SaveConfig(ctx)\n\t\t\tif tc.wantErr {\n\t\t\t\tif err == nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Fatal(\"expected an error\")\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\twant := filepath.Join(cfgDir, \"startup-config.cfg\")\n\t\t\tif res == nil || res.ConfigPath != want {\n\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"ConfigPath = %v, want %q\", res, want)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestVAOSSaveConfigTimeout(t *testing.T) {\n\tdoneFile := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), saveDoneFile)\n\n\t_, err := waitSaveDone(context.Background(), doneFile, 10*time.Millisecond)\n\tif err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"expected a timeout error\")\n\t}\n}",

30: 	StartupCfgFName     string
31: 	Credentials         *Credentials
32: }
33: 
34: func NewVRNode(n NodeOverwrites, creds *Credentials, scrapliPlatformName string) *VRNode {
35: 	vr := &VRNode{}
36: 
37: 	vr.DefaultNode = *NewDefaultNode(n)
38: 
39: 	vr.Credentials = creds
40: 	vr.ScrapliPlatformName = scrapliPlatformName
41: 
42: 	vr.InterfaceMappedPrefix = "eth"
43: 	vr.InterfaceOffset = 0
44: 	vr.FirstDataIfIndex = 1
45: 	vr.ConfigDirName = "config"
46: 	vr.StartupCfgFName = "startup-config.cfg"
47: 
48: 	return vr
49: }
50: 
51: // LinkApplyMode keeps vrnetlab-backed VM nodes on the conservative recreate
52: // path for apply link changes.
53: func (vr *VRNode) LinkApplyMode(ctx context.Context) LinkApplyMode {
54: 	return vr.ImageLinkApplyMode(ctx, LinkApplyModeRecreate)
55: }
56: 
57: // Init stub function.
58: func (n *VRNode) Init(cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig, opts ...NodeOption) error {
59: 	return nil
60: }
61: 
62: // PreDeploy default function: create lab directory, generate certificates, generate startup config
63: // file.
64: func (n *VRNode) PreDeploy(_ context.Context, params *PreDeployParams) error {
65: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(n.Cfg.LabDir, clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
66: 	_, err := n.LoadOrGenerateCertificate(params.Cert, params.TopologyName)
67: 	if err != nil {
68: 		return err
69: 	}
70: 	return LoadStartupConfigFileVr(n, n.ConfigDirName, n.StartupCfgFName)
71: }
72: 
73: // AddEndpoint override version maps the endpoint name to an ethX-based name before adding it to the
74: // node endpoints. Returns an error if the mapping goes wrong.
75: func (vr *VRNode) AddEndpoint(e clablinks.Endpoint) error {
76: 	endpointName := e.GetIfaceName()
77: 	// Slightly modified check: if it doesn't match the VMInterfaceRegexp, pass it to
78: 	// GetMappedInterfaceName. If it fails, then the interface name is wrong.
79: 	if vr.InterfaceRegexp != nil && !(VMInterfaceRegexp.MatchString(endpointName)) {
80: 		mappedName, err := vr.OverwriteNode.GetMappedInterfaceName(endpointName)
81: 		if err != nil {
82: 			return fmt.Errorf(
83: 				"%q interface name %q could not be mapped to an ethX-based interface name: %w",
84: 				vr.Cfg.ShortName,
85: 				e.GetIfaceName(),
86: 				err,
87: 			)
88: 		}
89: 		log.Debugf(
90: 			"Interface Mapping: Mapping interface %q (ifAlias) to %q (ifName)",
91: 			endpointName,
92: 			mappedName,
93: 		)
94: 		e.SetIfaceName(mappedName)
95: 		e.SetIfaceAlias(endpointName)
96: 	}
97: 
98: 	if e.GetNode() == nil {
99: 		e.SetNode(vr)
100: 	}
101: 
102: 	vr.Endpoints = append(vr.Endpoints, e)
103: 	return nil
104: }
105: 
106: // CheckInterfaceName checks interface names for generic VM-based nodes.
107: // Displays InterfaceHelp if the check fails for the expected VM interface regexp.
108: func (vr *VRNode) CheckInterfaceName() error {
109: 	err := vr.CheckInterfaceOverlap()
110: 	if err != nil {
111: 		return err
112: 	}
113: 
114: 	for _, ep := range vr.Endpoints {
115: 		ifName := ep.GetIfaceName()
116: 		if !VMInterfaceRegexp.MatchString(ifName) {
117: 			return fmt.Errorf(
118: 				"%q interface name %q does not match the required interface patterns: %q",
119: 				vr.Cfg.ShortName,
120: 				ifName,
121: 				vr.InterfaceHelp,
122: 			)
123: 		}
124: 	}
125: 
126: 	return nil
127: }
128: 
129: func (n *VRNode) SaveConfig(_ context.Context) (*SaveConfigResult, error) {
130: 	config, err := clabnetconf.GetConfig(n.Cfg.LongName,
131: 		n.Cfg.Credentials.Username,
132: 		n.Cfg.Credentials.Password,
133: 		n.ScrapliPlatformName,
134: 	)
135: 	if err != nil {
136: 		return nil, err
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	// Save config to mounted labdir startup config path
140: 	configPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.ConfigDirName, n.StartupCfgFName)
141: 	err = os.WriteFile(
142: 		configPath,
143: 		[]byte(config),
144: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen,
145: 	) // skipcq: GO-S2306
146: 	if err != nil {
147: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
148: 			"failed to write config by %s path from %s container: %v",
149: 			configPath,
150: 			n.Cfg.ShortName,
151: 			err,
152: 		)
153: 	}
154: 	log.Info("Saved configuration to path", "nodeName", n.Cfg.ShortName, "path", configPath)
155: 
156: 	return &SaveConfigResult{
157: 		ConfigPath: configPath,
158: 	}, nil
159: }
160: 
161: // PreStop prepares vrnetlab-specific state before DefaultNode.Stop parks interfaces and stops the
162: // container.
163: func (vr *VRNode) PreStop(ctx context.Context) error {
164: 	preStopPrepareVrnetlabQcowAlias(ctx, &vr.DefaultNode)
165: 	return nil
166: }
167: 
168: func preStopPrepareVrnetlabQcowAlias(ctx context.Context, d *DefaultNode) {
169: 	aliasName, ok := vrnetlabQcowAliasName(d.Config().Image)
170: 	if !ok {
171: 		log.Debugf(
172: 			"node %q pre-stop vrnetlab qcow alias skipped: unable to infer tag from image %q",
173: 			d.Config().ShortName,
174: 			d.Config().Image,
175: 		)
176: 		return
177: 	}
178: 
179: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
180: 	defer cancel()
181: 
182: 	// Some vrnetlab nodes rename the original versioned qcow image after first boot and fail on
183: 	// subsequent starts when they try to rediscover a versioned qcow filename. If there is exactly
184: 	// one non-overlay qcow file in / and our alias is absent, create a hardlink alias based on the
185: 	// image tag.
186: 	cmd := fmt.Sprintf(
187: 		`alias="/%s"; `+
188: 			`[ -e "$alias" ] && exit 0; `+
189: 			`src=""; `+
190: 			`if [ -f /sros.qcow2 ] && [ "/sros.qcow2" != "$alias" ]; then `+
191: 			`src="/sros.qcow2"; `+
192: 			`else `+
193: 			`set -- /*.qcow2; `+
194: 			`if [ "$1" != "/*.qcow2" ]; then `+
195: 			`for f in "$@"; do `+
196: 			`[ "$f" = "$alias" ] && continue; `+
197: 			`base="${f##*/}"; `+
198: 			`case "$base" in *overlay*.qcow2) continue ;; esac; `+
199: 			`if [ -n "$src" ]; then src=""; break; fi; `+
200: 			`src="$f"; `+
201: 			`done; `+
202: 			`fi; `+
203: 			`fi; `+
204: 			`[ -n "$src" ] || exit 0; `+
205: 			`ln "$src" "$alias"`,
206: 		aliasName,
207: 	)
208: 
209: 	execCmd := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromSlice([]string{"sh", "-lc", cmd})
210: 	res, err := d.RunExec(ctx, execCmd)
211: 	if err != nil {
212: 		log.Warnf(
213: 			"node %q pre-stop vrnetlab qcow alias preparation failed: %v",
214: 			d.Config().ShortName,
215: 			err,
216: 		)
217: 		return
218: 	}
219: 
220: 	if res != nil && res.ReturnCode != 0 {
221: 		log.Warnf(
222: 			"node %q pre-stop vrnetlab qcow alias prep returned code %d (stderr: %s)",
223: 			d.Config().ShortName,
224: 			res.ReturnCode,
225: 			res.Stderr,
226: 		)
227: 	}
228: }
229: 
230: func vrnetlabQcowAliasName(image string) (string, bool) {
231: 	tag, ok := imageTag(image)
232: 	if !ok {
233: 		return "", false
234: 	}
235: 
236: 	return "clab-" + tag + ".qcow2", true
237: }
238: 
239: func imageTag(image string) (string, bool) {
240: 	if at := strings.LastIndex(image, "@"); at != -1 {
241: 		image = image[:at]
242: 	}
243: 
244: 	lastSlash := strings.LastIndex(image, "/")
245: 	lastColon := strings.LastIndex(image, ":")
246: 	if lastColon == -1 || lastColon < lastSlash {
247: 		return "", false
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	tag := image[lastColon+1:]
251: 	if tag == "" {
252: 		return "", false
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	if !imageTagRE.MatchString(tag) {
256: 		return "", false
257: 	}
258: 
259: 	return tag, true
260: }

override version maps the endpoint name to an ethX-based name before adding it to the\n// node endpoints. Returns an error if the mapping goes wrong.\nfunc (vr *VRNode) AddEndpoint(e clablinks.Endpoint) error {\n\tendpointName := e.GetIfaceName()\n\t// Slightly modified check: if it doesn't match the VMInterfaceRegexp, pass it to\n\t// GetMappedInterfaceName. err\n\t}\n\n\t// Save config to mounted labdir startup config path\n\tconfigPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, n.ConfigDirName, n.StartupCfgFName)\n\terr = path from %s container: %v\",\n\t\t\tconfigPath,\n\t\t\tn.Cfg.ShortName,\n\t\t\terr,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\tlog.Info(\"Saved configuration to path\", \"nodeName\", n.Cfg.ShortName, \"path\", configPath)\n\n\treturn &SaveConfigResult{\n\t\tConfigPath: configPath,\n\t}, nil\n}\n\n// PreStop prepares vrnetlab-specific state before DefaultNode.Stop parks interfaces and stops the\n// container.\nfunc (vr *VRNode) PreStop(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tpreStopPrepareVrnetlabQcowAlias(ctx, &vr.DefaultNode)\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc preStopPrepareVrnetlabQcowAlias(ctx context.Context, d *DefaultNode) {\n\taliasName, ok := vrnetlabQcowAliasName(d.Config().Image)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tlog.Debugf(\n\t\t\t\"node %q pre-stop vrnetlab qcow alias skipped: unable to infer tag from image %q\",\n\t\t\td.Config().ShortName,\n\t\t\td.Config().Image,\n\t\t)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)\n\tdefer cancel()\n\n\t// Some vrnetlab nodes rename the original versioned qcow image after first boot and fail on\n\t// subsequent starts when they try to rediscover a versioned qcow filename. If there is exactly\n\t// one non-overlay qcow file in / and our alias is absent, create a hardlink alias based on the\n\t// image tag.\n\tcmd := fmt.Sprintf(\n\t\t`alias=\"/%s\"; `+\n\t\t\t`[ -e \"$alias\" ] && exit 0; `+\n\t\t\t`src=\"\"; `+\n\t\t\t`if [ -f /sros.qcow2 ] && [ \"/sros.qcow2\" != \"$alias\" ]; then `+\n\t\t\t`src=\"/sros.qcow2\"; `+\n\t\t\t`else `+\n\t\t\t`set -- /*.qcow2; `+\n\t\t\t`if [ \"$1\" != \"/*.qcow2\" ]; then `+\n\t\t\t`for f in \"$@\"; do `+\n\t\t\t`[ \"$f\" = \"$alias\" ] && continue; `+\n\t\t\t`base=\"${f##*/}\"; `+\n\t\t\t`case \"$base\" in *overlay*.qcow2) continue ;; esac; `+\n\t\t\t`if [ -n \"$src\" ]; then src=\"\"; break; fi; `+\n\t\t\t`src=\"$f\"; `+\n\t\t\t`done; `+\n\t\t\t`fi; `+\n\t\t\t`fi; `+\n\t\t\t`[ -n \"$src\" ] || exit 0; `+\n\t\t\t`ln \"$src\" \"$alias\"`,\n\t\taliasName,\n\t)\n\n\texecCmd := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromSlice([]string{\"sh\", \"-lc\", cmd})\n\tres, err := d.RunExec(ctx, execCmd)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warnf(\n\t\t\t\"node %q pre-stop vrnetlab qcow alias preparation failed: %v\",\n\t\t\td.Config().ShortName,\n\t\t\terr,\n\t\t)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tif res != nil && res.ReturnCode != 0 {\n\t\tlog.Warnf(\n\t\t\t\"node %q pre-stop vrnetlab qcow alias prep returned code %d (stderr: %s)\",\n\t\t\td.Config().ShortName,\n\t\t\tres.ReturnCode,\n\t\t\tres.Stderr,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc vrnetlabQcowAliasName(image string) (string, bool) {\n\ttag, ok := imageTag(image)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn \"\", false\n\t}\n\n\treturn \"clab-\" + tag + \".qcow2\", true\n}\n\nfunc imageTag(image string) (string, bool) {\n\tif at := strings.LastIndex(image, \"@\"); 46: // DefaultNode implements the Node interface and is embedded to the structs of all other nodes.
47: // It has common fields and methods that every node should typically have. Nodes can override
48: // methods if needed.
49: type DefaultNode struct {
50: 	Cfg              *clabtypes.NodeConfig
51: 	Mgmt             *clabtypes.MgmtNet
52: 	Runtime          clabruntime.ContainerRuntime
53: 	HostRequirements *clabtypes.HostRequirements
54: 	// SSHConfig is the SSH client configuration that a clab node requires.
55: 	SSHConfig *clabtypes.SSHConfig
56: 	// Indicates that the node should not start without no license file defined
57: 	LicensePolicy clabtypes.LicensePolicy
58: 	// OverwriteNode stores the interface used to overwrite methods defined
59: 	// for DefaultNode, so that particular nodes can provide custom implementations.
60: 	OverwriteNode NodeOverwrites
61: 	// List of link endpoints that are connected to the node.
62: 	Endpoints []clablinks.Endpoint
63: 	// Preserve topology endpoint objects while they belong to the parking node.
64: 	parkingNode *clablinks.ParkingNode
65: 	// Interface aliasing-related variables
66: 	InterfaceRegexp       *regexp.Regexp
67: 	InterfaceMappedPrefix string
68: 	InterfaceOffset       int
69: 	InterfaceHelp         string
70: 	FirstDataIfIndex      int
71: 	// State of the node
72: 	state      clabnodesstate.NodeState
73: 	statemutex sync.RWMutex
74: 	StopSignal clabtypes.Signal
75: }

77: // NewDefaultNode initializes the DefaultNode structure and receives a NodeOverwrites interface
78: // which is implemented by the node struct of a particular kind.
79: // This allows DefaultNode to access fields of the specific node struct in the methods defined for
80: // DefaultNode.
81: func NewDefaultNode(n NodeOverwrites) *DefaultNode {
82: 	dn := &DefaultNode{
83: 		HostRequirements: clabtypes.NewHostRequirements(),
84: 		OverwriteNode:    n,
85: 		LicensePolicy:    clabtypes.LicensePolicyNone,
86: 		SSHConfig:        clabtypes.NewSSHConfig(),
87: 	}
88: 
89: 	dn.InterfaceMappedPrefix = "eth"
90: 	dn.InterfaceOffset = 0
91: 	dn.FirstDataIfIndex = 0
92: 
93: 	return dn
94: }

97: 	m := d.Runtime.Mgmt()

99: 		return nil

116: // PreDeploy is a common method for all nodes that is called before the node is deployed.
117: func (d *DefaultNode) PreDeploy(_ context.Context, params *PreDeployParams) error {

119: 		return nil
120: 	}
121: 	_, err := d.LoadOrGenerateCertificate(params.Cert, params.TopologyName)
122: 	if err != nil {

124: 	}

167: 	for imageKey, imageName := range d.OverwriteNode.GetImages(ctx) {

169: 			return fmt.Errorf(
170: 				"missing required %q attribute for node %q",
171: 				imageKey,
172: 				d.Cfg.ShortName,
173: 			)
174: 		}

176: 		if err != nil {
177: 			return err
178: 		}
179: 	}
180: 	return nil
181: }

187: func (d *DefaultNode) Deploy(ctx context.Context, _ *DeployParams) error {
188: 	// Set the "CLAB_INTFS" variable to the number of interfaces (endpoints) a node has.
189: 	// This env var does not count in the eth0 interface that is automatically created by the
190: 	// container runtime. This env var is used by some containers (e.g. vrnetlab systems) to
191: 	// postpone the startup until all interfaces
192: 	// have been added to the container namespace.
193: 	d.Config().Env[clabconstants.ClabEnvIntfs] = strconv.Itoa(len(d.GetEndpoints()))
194: 
195: 	// create the container
196: 	cID, err := d.Runtime.CreateContainer(ctx, d.Cfg)
197: 	if err != nil {
198: 		return err
199: 	}
200: 
201: 	// start the container
202: 	_, err = d.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cID, d)
203: 	if err != nil {
204: 		return err
205: 	}
206: 
207: 	// Update the nodes state
208: 	d.SetState(clabnodesstate.Deployed)
209: 
210: 	return nil
211: }

215: 	var err error
216: 	nsp := ""

218: 	if d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {

229: 			return "", err
230: 		}
231: 	}
232: 
233: 	return nsp, err
234: }

241: // LinkApplyMode returns the conservative default for node kinds that do not
242: // explicitly opt into live hotplug or restart handling.
243: func (d *DefaultNode) LinkApplyMode(ctx context.Context) LinkApplyMode {
244: 	if d.Cfg != nil && (d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased || d.Cfg.SkipUniquenessCheck) {
245: 		return LinkApplyModeLive
246: 	}

250: // ImageLinkApplyMode allows node kinds to keep their normal fallback behavior
251: // while opting into live link apply when their image declares support for it.
252: func (d *DefaultNode) ImageLinkApplyMode(
253: 	ctx context.Context,
254: 	fallback LinkApplyMode,
255: ) LinkApplyMode {
256: 	if d.imageHasBoxenVendorLabel(ctx) {
257: 		return LinkApplyModeLive
258: 	}
259: 
260: 	return fallback
261: }

263: func (d *DefaultNode) imageHasBoxenVendorLabel(ctx context.Context) bool {
264: 	if d == nil || d.Cfg == nil || d.Cfg.Image == "" {
265: 		return false
266: 	}
267: 	if d.Runtime == nil {
268: 		log.Debug("Skipping image label check for apply link hotplug support",
269: 			"image", d.Cfg.Image,
270: 			"reason", "node runtime is not initialized",
271: 		)
272: 		return false
273: 	}
274: 
275: 	inspect, err := d.Runtime.InspectImage(ctx, d.Cfg.Image)
276: 	if err != nil {
277: 		log.Debug("Failed to inspect image for apply link hotplug support",
278: 			"image", d.Cfg.Image,
279: 			"error", err,
280: 		)
281: 		return false
282: 	}
283: 	if inspect == nil || inspect.Config.Labels == nil {
284: 		return false
285: 	}
286: 
287: 	return inspect.Config.Labels[boxenImageVendorLabel] == boxenImageVendorValue
288: }

389: func (d *DefaultNode) ComputeReconcilePlan(diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff) *ReconcileResult {
390: 	result := &ReconcileResult{Action: clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone}
391: 
392: 	if diff == nil || !diff.HasDiff() {
393: 		return result
394: 	}
395: 
396: 	action := diff.DefaultAction()
397: 	result.Action = action
398: 
399: 	switch action {
400: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:
401: 		result.Restarted = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}
402: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:
403: 		result.Recreated = []string{d.Cfg.LongName}
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	return result
407: }
408: 
409: func (d *DefaultNode) GetReconcilePlan(
410: 	_ context.Context,
411: 	diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff,
412: ) (*ReconcileResult, error) {
413: 	return d.ComputeReconcilePlan(diff), nil
414: }
415: 
416: // Reconcile applies the diff and executes the appropriate action (restart/recreate).
417: func (d *DefaultNode) Reconcile(
418: 	ctx context.Context,
419: 	diff *clabtypes.TopologyDiff,
420: ) (*ReconcileResult, error) {
421: 	result := d.ComputeReconcilePlan(diff)
422: 
423: 	if result.Action == clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionNone {
424: 		return result, nil
425: 	}
426: 
427: 	log.Info(
428: 		"Applying node changes",
429: 		"node",
430: 		d.Cfg.ShortName,
431: 		"action",
432: 		result.Action,
433: 		"fields",
434: 		diff.Fields,
435: 	)
436: 
437: 	switch result.Action {
438: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRestart:
439: 		if err := d.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
440: 			return result, fmt.Errorf("stop failed: %w", err)
441: 		}
442: 		if err := d.Start(ctx); err != nil {
443: 			return result, fmt.Errorf("start failed: %w", err)
444: 		}
445: 
446: 	case clabtypes.TopologyDiffActionRecreate:
447: 		if err := d.Delete(ctx); err != nil {
448: 			return result, fmt.Errorf("delete failed: %w", err)
449: 		}
450: 	}
451: 
452: 	return result, nil
453: }

472: func (d *DefaultNode) Delete(ctx context.Context) error {
473: 	for _, e := range d.Endpoints {
474: 		err := e.GetLink().Remove(ctx)
475: 		if err != nil {
476: 			return err
477: 		}
478: 	}
479: 
480: 	if d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {
481: 		return nil
482: 	}
483: 
484: 	return d.Runtime.DeleteContainer(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())
485: }

495: 		{
496: 			FilterType: "name",
497: 			Match:      d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(),
498: 		},
499: 	})
500: 	if err != nil {
501: 		return nil, err
502: 	}
503: 	// check that we retrieved some container information
504: 	// otherwise throw ErrContainersNotFound error
505: 	if len(cnts) == 0 {
506: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
507: 			"Node: %s. %w",
508: 			d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(),
509: 			ErrContainersNotFound,
510: 		)
511: 	}
512: 
513: 	return cnts, err

516: func (d *DefaultNode) RunExecFromConfig(ctx context.Context, ec *clabexec.ExecCollection) error {
517: 	for _, e := range d.Config().Exec {
518: 		exec, err := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(e)
519: 		if err != nil {
520: 			log.Warnf("Failed to parse the command string: %s, %v", e, err)
521: 		}
522: 
523: 		res, err := d.OverwriteNode.RunExec(ctx, exec)
524: 		if err != nil {
525: 			// kinds which do not support exec functionality are skipped
526: 			continue
527: 		}
528: 
529: 		ec.Add(d.GetShortName(), res)
530: 	}
531: 	return nil
532: }

534: func (d *DefaultNode) UpdateConfigWithRuntimeInfo(ctx context.Context) error {
535: 	cnts, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainers(ctx)
536: 	if err != nil {
537: 		return err
538: 	}
539: 
540: 	if len(cnts) == 0 {
541: 		return fmt.Errorf("no container runtime information retrieved")
542: 	}
543: 
544: 	// network settings of a first container only
545: 	netSettings := cnts[0].NetworkSettings
546: 
547: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address = netSettings.IPv4addr
548: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv4PrefixLength = netSettings.IPv4pLen
549: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address = netSettings.IPv6addr
550: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv6PrefixLength = netSettings.IPv6pLen
551: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Gateway = netSettings.IPv4Gw
552: 	d.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Gateway = netSettings.IPv6Gw
553: 
554: 	d.Cfg.ContainerID = cnts[0].ID
555: 
556: 	d.Cfg.ResultingPortBindings = cnts[0].Ports
557: 
558: 	return nil
559: }

567: func (d *DefaultNode) CheckInterfaceOverlap() error {
568: 	var seenEps []clablinks.Endpoint
569: 
570: 	for _, ep := range d.Endpoints {
571: 		ifName := ep.GetIfaceName()
572: 		for _, seenEp := range seenEps {
573: 			if ifName == seenEp.GetIfaceName() {
574: 				return fmt.Errorf("%q and %q have overlapping interface names", ep, seenEp)
575: 			}
576: 		}
577: 		seenEps = append(seenEps, ep)
578: 	}
579: 
580: 	return nil
581: }

583: // CheckInterfaceName checks if a name of the interface referenced in the topology file is in the
584: // expected range of name values.
585: // A no-op for the default node, specific nodes should implement this method.
586: func (d *DefaultNode) CheckInterfaceName() error {
587: 	return d.CheckInterfaceOverlap()
588: }

590: // CalculateInterfaceIndex parses the supplied interface name with the InterfaceRegexp.
591: // Using the the port offset, it calculates the mapped interface index based on the InterfaceOffset
592: // and the first data interface index.
593: func (d *DefaultNode) CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName string) (int, error) {
594: 	captureGroups, err := clabutils.GetRegexpCaptureGroups(d.InterfaceRegexp, ifName)
595: 	if err != nil {
596: 		return 0, err
597: 	}
598: 
599: 	if parsedIndex, found := captureGroups["port"]; found {
600: 		parsedIndexInt, err := strconv.Atoi(parsedIndex)
601: 		if err != nil {
602: 			return 0, fmt.Errorf(
603: 				"%q parsed index %q could not be cast to an integer",
604: 				ifName,
605: 				parsedIndex,
606: 			)
607: 		}
608: 		calculatedIndex := parsedIndexInt - d.InterfaceOffset + d.FirstDataIfIndex
609: 		return calculatedIndex, nil
610: 	} else {
611: 		return 0, fmt.Errorf(
612: 			"%q does not have extracted interface index with regexp %q, 'port' capture group missing?",
613: 			ifName,
614: 			d.InterfaceRegexp,
615: 		)
616: 	}
617: }
618: 
619: // GetMappedInterfaceName returns with a mapped interface name based on the mapped interface prefix
620: // and calculated mapped interface index.
621: func (d *DefaultNode) GetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error) {
622: 	ifIndex, err := d.OverwriteNode.CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName)
623: 	if err != nil {
624: 		return "", err
625: 	}
626: 	if ifIndex < d.FirstDataIfIndex {
627: 		return "", fmt.Errorf(
628: 			"extracted interface index for %q is out of bounds: %d ! >= %d",
629: 			ifName,
630: 			ifIndex,
631: 			d.FirstDataIfIndex,
632: 		)
633: 	}
634: 	mappedIfName := fmt.Sprintf("%s%d", d.InterfaceMappedPrefix, ifIndex)
635: 
636: 	return mappedIfName, nil
637: }

639: // VerifyStartupConfig verifies that startup config files exists on disks.
640: func (d *DefaultNode) VerifyStartupConfig(topoDir string) error {
641: 	cfg := d.Config().StartupConfig
642: 	if cfg == "" {
643: 		return nil
644: 	}
645: 
646: 	rcfg := clabutils.ResolvePath(cfg, topoDir)
647: 	if !clabutils.FileExists(rcfg) {
648: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q startup-config file not found by the path %s",
649: 			d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), rcfg)
650: 	}
651: 
652: 	return nil
653: }

655: // GenerateConfig generates configuration for the nodes
656: // out of the template `t` based on the node configuration and saves the result to dst.
657: // If the config file is already present in the node dir we do not regenerate the config unless
658: // EnforceStartupConfig is explicitly set to true and startup-config points to a file this will
659: // persist the changes that users make to a running config when booted from some startup config.
660: func (d *DefaultNode) GenerateConfig(dst, t string) error {
661: 	// Check for incompatible options
662: 	if d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && d.Cfg.SuppressStartupConfig {
663: 		return ErrIncompatibleOptions
664: 	}
665: 	if d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && d.Cfg.StartupConfig == "" {
666: 		return ErrNoStartupConfig
667: 	}
668: 
669: 	if d.Cfg.SuppressStartupConfig {
670: 		log.Info("Startup config generation suppressed", "node", d.Cfg.ShortName)
671: 		return nil
672: 	}
673: 
674: 	if !d.Cfg.EnforceStartupConfig && clabutils.FileExists(dst) {
675: 		log.Debug("Existing config found", "node", d.Cfg.ShortName, "path", dst)
676: 		return nil
677: 	} else {
678: 		log.Debug("Generating config", "node", d.Cfg.ShortName, "file", d.Cfg.StartupConfig)
679: 
680: 		cfgBuf, err := clabutils.SubstituteEnvsAndTemplate(strings.NewReader(t), d.Cfg)
681: 		if err != nil {
682: 			return err
683: 		}
684: 		log.Debug("Generated config", "node", d.Cfg.ShortName, "content", cfgBuf.String())
685: 
686: 		f, err := os.Create(dst)
687: 		if err != nil {
688: 			return err
689: 		}
690: 		defer f.Close()
691: 
692: 		_, err = f.Write(cfgBuf.Bytes())
693: 		if err != nil {
694: 			return err
695: 		}
696: 	}
697: 
698: 	return nil
699: }
700: 
701: // NodeOverwrites is an interface that every node implements.
702: // It is used to enable DefaultNode to get access to the particular node structs
703: // and is provided as an argument of the NewDefaultNode function.
704: // The methods defined for this interfaces are the methods that particular node has a custom
705: // implementation of.
706: type NodeOverwrites interface {
707: 	VerifyStartupConfig(topoDir string) error
708: 	CheckInterfaceName() error
709: 	CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName string) (int, error)
710: 	GetMappedInterfaceName(ifName string) (string, error)
711: 	VerifyHostRequirements() error
712: 	PullImage(ctx context.Context) error
713: 	GetImages(ctx context.Context) map[string]string
714: 	GetContainers(ctx context.Context) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error)
715: 	GetContainerName() string
716: 	GetContainerStatus(ctx context.Context) clabruntime.ContainerStatus
717: 	VerifyContainerName() error
718: 	VerifyLicenseFileExists(context.Context) error
719: 	PreStop(context.Context) error
720: 	RunExec(context.Context, *clabexec.ExecCmd) (*clabexec.ExecResult, error)
721: 	GetNSPath(ctx context.Context) (string, error)
722: }
723: 
724: // LoadStartupConfigFileVr templates a startup-config using the file specified for VM-based nodes in
725: // the topo
726: // and puts the resulting config file by the LabDir/configDirName/startupCfgFName path.
727: func LoadStartupConfigFileVr(node Node, configDirName, startupCfgFName string) error {
728: 	nodeCfg := node.Config()
729: 	// create config directory that will be bind mounted to vrnetlab container at / path
730: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(nodeCfg.LabDir, configDirName),
731: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
732: 
733: 	if nodeCfg.StartupConfig != "" {
734: 		// dstCfg is a path to a file on the clab host that will have rendered configuration
735: 		dstCfg := filepath.Join(nodeCfg.LabDir, configDirName, startupCfgFName)
736: 
737: 		c, err := os.ReadFile(nodeCfg.StartupConfig)
738: 		if err != nil {
739: 			return err
740: 		}
741: 
742: 		cfgTemplate := string(c)
743: 
744: 		err = node.GenerateConfig(dstCfg, cfgTemplate)
745: 		if err != nil {
746: 			log.Errorf("node=%s, failed to generate config: %v", nodeCfg.ShortName, err)
747: 		}
748: 	}
749: 	return nil
750: }

752: // GetContainerName returns the name used by the runtime to identify the container
753: // e.g. ext-container nodes use the name as defined in the topo file, while most other containers
754: // use long (prefixed) name.
755: func (d *DefaultNode) GetContainerName() string {
756: 	return d.Cfg.LongName
757: }

759: func (d *DefaultNode) VerifyContainerName() error {
760: 	containerName := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName()
761: 	if !containerNamePatternRe.MatchString(containerName) {
762: 		return fmt.Errorf("Node name contains invalid characters: %s", containerName)
763: 	}
764: 
765: 	if len(containerName) > maxNameLength {
766: 		log.Warn(
767: 			"Node name will not resolve via DNS",
768: 			"name",
769: 			containerName,
770: 			"reason",
771: 			fmt.Sprintf("name exceeds %d characters", maxNameLength),
772: 		)
773: 	}
774: 
775: 	if strings.ContainsAny(containerName, dnsIncompatibleChars) {
776: 		log.Warn(
777: 			"Node name will not resolve via DNS",
778: 			"name",
779: 			containerName,
780: 			"reason",
781: 			"name contains invalid characters such as '.' and/or '_'",
782: 		)
783: 	}
784: 
785: 	return nil
786: }

788: // RunExec executes a single command for a node.
789: func (d *DefaultNode) RunExec(
790: 	ctx context.Context,
791: 	execCmd *clabexec.ExecCmd,
792: ) (*clabexec.ExecResult, error) {
793: 	execResult, err := d.GetRuntime().Exec(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd)
794: 	if err != nil {
795: 		log.Errorf("%s: failed to execute cmd: %q with error %v",
796: 			d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd.GetCmdString(), err)
797: 		return nil, err
798: 	}
799: 	return execResult, nil
800: }

802: // RunExecNotWait executes a command for a node, and doesn't block waiting for the output.
803: // Should be overridden if the nodes implementation differs.
804: func (d *DefaultNode) RunExecNotWait(ctx context.Context, execCmd *clabexec.ExecCmd) error {
805: 	err := d.GetRuntime().ExecNotWait(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd)
806: 	if err != nil {
807: 		log.Errorf("%s: failed to execute cmd: %q with error %v",
808: 			d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName(), execCmd.GetCmdString(), err)
809: 		return err
810: 	}
811: 	return nil
812: }

814: // VerifyLicenseFileExists checks if a license file with a provided path exists.
815: func (d *DefaultNode) VerifyLicenseFileExists(_ context.Context) error {
816: 	if d.Config().License == "" {
817: 		switch d.LicensePolicy {
818: 		// if a license is required by the kind but not provided
819: 		case clabtypes.LicensePolicyRequired:
820: 			return fmt.Errorf(
821: 				"node %s of kind %s requires a license. Provide one via 'license' knob in the topology file",
822: 				d.Config().ShortName,
823: 				d.Cfg.Kind,
824: 			)
825: 		case clabtypes.LicensePolicyWarn:
826: 			// just warn when no license is provided
827: 			log.Warnf(
828: 				"node %s of kind %s requires a license. Make sure to provide it in some way (e.g. license knob or baked into image)",
829: 				d.Config().ShortName,
830: 				d.Cfg.Kind,
831: 			)
832: 			return nil
833: 		case clabtypes.LicensePolicyNone:
834: 			// license is not required
835: 			return nil
836: 		default:
837: 			return fmt.Errorf("unknown license policy value %s for node %s kind %s",
838: 				d.LicensePolicy, d.Config().ShortName, d.Cfg.Kind)
839: 		}
840: 	}
841: 	// if license is provided check path exists
842: 	rlic := clabutils.ResolvePath(d.Config().License, d.Cfg.LabDir)
843: 	if !clabutils.FileExists(rlic) {
844: 		return fmt.Errorf(
845: 			"license file for node %q is not found by the path %s",
846: 			d.Config().ShortName,
847: 			rlic,
848: 		)
849: 	}
850: 
851: 	return nil
852: }
853: 
854: // LoadOrGenerateCertificate loads a certificate using a certificate storage provider
855: // provided in certInfra or generates a new one if it does not exist.
856: func (d *DefaultNode) LoadOrGenerateCertificate(
857: 	certInfra *clabcert.Cert,
858: 	topoName string,
859: ) (nodeCert *clabcert.Certificate, err error) {
860: 	// early return if certificate generation is not required
861: 	if d.Cfg.Certificate == nil || !*d.Cfg.Certificate.Issue {
862: 		return nil, nil
863: 	}
864: 
865: 	nodeConfig := d.Cfg
866: 
867: 	// try loading existing certificates from disk and generate new ones if they do not exist
868: 	nodeCert, err = certInfra.LoadNodeCert(nodeConfig.ShortName)
869: 	if err != nil {
870: 		log.Debugf("creating node certificate for %s", nodeConfig.ShortName)
871: 
872: 		hosts := []string{
873: 			nodeConfig.ShortName,
874: 			nodeConfig.LongName,
875: 			nodeConfig.ShortName + "." + topoName + ".io",
876: 		}
877: 		// add the SANs provided via config
878: 		hosts = append(hosts, nodeConfig.Certificate.SANs...)
879: 
880: 		// add mgmt IPs as SANs to CSR
881: 		for _, ip := range []string{d.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address, d.Cfg.MgmtIPv6Address} {
882: 			if ip != "" {
883: 				hosts = append(hosts, ip)
884: 			}
885: 		}
886: 
887: 		certInput := &clabcert.NodeCSRInput{
888: 			CommonName:   nodeConfig.ShortName + "." + topoName + ".io",
889: 			Hosts:        hosts,
890: 			Organization: "containerlab",
891: 			Country:      "US",
892: 			KeySize:      d.Cfg.Certificate.KeySize,
893: 			Expiry:       d.Cfg.Certificate.ValidityDuration,
894: 		}
895: 		// Generate the cert for the node
896: 		nodeCert, err = certInfra.GenerateAndSignNodeCert(certInput)
897: 		if err != nil {
898: 			return nil, err
899: 		}
900: 
901: 		// persist the cert via certStorage
902: 		err = certInfra.StoreNodeCert(nodeConfig.ShortName, nodeCert)
903: 		if err != nil {
904: 			return nil, err
905: 		}
906: 	}
907: 
908: 	return nodeCert, nil
909: }
910: 
911: func (d *DefaultNode) GetHostsEntries(ctx context.Context) (clabtypes.HostEntries, error) {
912: 	containers, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainers(ctx)
913: 	if err != nil {
914: 		return nil, err
915: 	}
916: 
917: 	result := clabtypes.HostEntries{}
918: 
919: 	for idx := range containers {
920: 		if len(containers[idx].Names) == 0 {
921: 			continue
922: 		}
923: 		if containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv4addr != "" {
924: 			result = append(result, clabtypes.NewHostEntry(
925: 				containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv4addr,
926: 				containers[idx].Names[0],
927: 				clabtypes.IpVersionV4,
928: 			).SetDescription(fmt.Sprintf("Kind: %s", d.Cfg.Kind)).SetContainerID(containers[idx].ID))
929: 		}
930: 		if containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv6addr != "" {
931: 			result = append(result, clabtypes.NewHostEntry(
932: 				containers[idx].NetworkSettings.IPv6addr,
933: 				containers[idx].Names[0],
934: 				clabtypes.IpVersionV6,
935: 			).SetDescription(fmt.Sprintf("Kind: %s", d.Cfg.Kind)).SetContainerID(containers[idx].ID))
936: 		}
937: 	}
938: 	return result, nil
939: }
940: 
941: func (d *DefaultNode) AddLinkToContainer(
942: 	ctx context.Context,
943: 	link netlink.Link,
944: 	f func(ns.NetNS) error,
945: ) error {
946: 	if !d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {
947: 		st := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)
948: 		if !clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(st) {
949: 			if st == clabruntime.Stopped {
950: 				containerName := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName()
951: 				d.GetRuntime().LogNonRunningContainerOutput(ctx, containerName)
952: 			}
953: 			return fmt.Errorf(
954: 				"node %q: cannot attach link, container network namespace is not available (status=%s)",
955: 				d.Cfg.ShortName,
956: 				st,
957: 			)
958: 		}
959: 	}
960: 	// retrieve nodes nspath
961: 	nsp, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
962: 	if err != nil {
963: 		return err
964: 	}
965: 	// retrieve the namespace handle
966: 	netns, err := ns.GetNS(nsp)
967: 	if err != nil {
968: 		return err
969: 	}
970: 	// move veth endpoint to namespace
971: 	if err := netlink.LinkSetNsFd(link, int(netns.Fd())); err != nil {
972: 		return err
973: 	}
974: 	// execute the given function
975: 	err = netns.Do(f)
976: 	if err != nil {
977: 		return err
978: 	}
979: 	return nil
980: }
981: 
982: // ExecFunction executes the given function in the nodes network namespace.
983: func (d *DefaultNode) ExecFunction(ctx context.Context, f func(ns.NetNS) error) error {
984: 	if !d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {
985: 		st := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)
986: 		if !clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(st) {
987: 			if st == clabruntime.Stopped {
988: 				containerName := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName()
989: 				d.GetRuntime().LogNonRunningContainerOutput(ctx, containerName)
990: 			}
991: 			return fmt.Errorf(
992: 				"node %q: cannot exec a command, container network namespace is not available (status=%s)",
993: 				d.Cfg.ShortName,
994: 				st,
995: 			)
996: 		}
997: 	}
998: 	// retrieve nodes nspath
999: 	nspath, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetNSPath(ctx)
1000: 	if err != nil {
1001: 		return err
1002: 	}
1003: 
1004: 	if d.Cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {
1005: 		nshandle, err := ns.GetCurrentNS()
1006: 		if err != nil {
1007: 			return err
1008: 		}
1009: 		nspath = nshandle.Path()
1010: 	}
1011: 
1012: 	if nspath == "" {
1013: 		return fmt.Errorf("nspath is not set for node %q", d.GetShortName())
1014: 	}
1015: 
1016: 	// retrieve the namespace handle
1017: 	netns, err := ns.GetNS(nspath)
1018: 	if err != nil {
1019: 		return err
1020: 	}
1021: 	// execute the given function
1022: 	return netns.Do(f)
1023: }

1025: // AddEndpoint maps the endpoint name to before adding it to the node endpoints if it matches the
1026: // interface alias regexp. Returns an error if the mapping goes wrong.
1027: func (d *DefaultNode) AddEndpoint(e clablinks.Endpoint) error {
1028: 	endpointName := e.GetIfaceName()
1029: 	if d.InterfaceRegexp != nil && d.InterfaceRegexp.MatchString(endpointName) {
1030: 		mappedName, err := d.OverwriteNode.GetMappedInterfaceName(endpointName)
1031: 		if err != nil {
1032: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1033: 				"%q interface name %q could not be mapped: %w",
1034: 				d.Cfg.ShortName,
1035: 				e.GetIfaceName(),
1036: 				err,
1037: 			)
1038: 		}
1039: 		log.Debugf(
1040: 			"Interface Mapping: Mapping interface %q (ifAlias) to %q (ifName)",
1041: 			endpointName,
1042: 			mappedName,
1043: 		)
1044: 		e.SetIfaceName(mappedName)
1045: 		e.SetIfaceAlias(endpointName)
1046: 	}
1047: 
1048: 	if e.GetNode() == nil {
1049: 		e.SetNode(d)
1050: 	}
1051: 
1052: 	d.Endpoints = append(d.Endpoints, e)
1053: 	return nil
1054: }

1056: func (d *DefaultNode) AdoptEndpoint(e clablinks.Endpoint) error {
1057: 	if e == nil {
1058: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q cannot adopt a nil endpoint", d.Cfg.ShortName)
1059: 	}
1060: 
1061: 	owner := e.GetNode()
1062: 	if owner == nil {
1063: 		return fmt.Errorf(
1064: 			"node %q cannot adopt endpoint %q without an owner",
1065: 			d.Cfg.ShortName,
1066: 			e.GetIfaceName(),
1067: 		)
1068: 	}
1069: 
1070: 	if owner.GetShortName() != d.Cfg.ShortName {
1071: 		return fmt.Errorf(
1072: 			"node %q cannot adopt endpoint %q owned by %q",
1073: 			d.Cfg.ShortName,
1074: 			e.GetIfaceName(),
1075: 			owner.GetShortName(),
1076: 		)
1077: 	}
1078: 
1079: 	for _, owned := range d.Endpoints {
1080: 		if owned == e {
1081: 			return nil
1082: 		}
1083: 		if owned.GetIfaceName() == e.GetIfaceName() {
1084: 			return fmt.Errorf(
1085: 				"node %q already tracks interface %q",
1086: 				d.Cfg.ShortName,
1087: 				e.GetIfaceName(),
1088: 			)
1089: 		}
1090: 	}
1091: 
1092: 	d.Endpoints = append(d.Endpoints, e)
1093: 
1094: 	return nil
1095: }

1097: func (d *DefaultNode) ReleaseEndpoint(e clablinks.Endpoint) error {
1098: 	for i, ep := range d.Endpoints {

1101: 		}
1102:

1168: // ParkEndpoints moves all tracked endpoints into the node-owned parking namespace.
1169: func (d *DefaultNode) ParkEndpoints(ctx context.Context) error {
1170: 	parkPath, err := clabutils.CreateOrGetNamedNetNS(d.parkingNetNSName())
1171: 	if err != nil {
1172: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create parking netns for node %q: %w", d.Cfg.ShortName, err)
1173: 	}
1174: 	// Reuse the parking node retained by a failed restore so it keeps the parked endpoints.
1175: 	parkingNode := d.parkingNode
1176: 	reused := parkingNode != nil
1177: 	if !reused {
1178: 		parkingNode = clablinks.NewParkingNode(d.Cfg.LongName, parkPath)
1179: 	}
1180: 
1181: 	if err := parkingNode.CaptureFrom(ctx, d); err != nil {
1182: 		if !reused {
1183: 			_ = d.cleanupParkingNetNS()
1184: 		}
1185: 		return err
1186: 	}
1187: 
1188: 	if err := parkingNode.RepointSymlink(); err != nil {
1189: 		repointErr := fmt.Errorf("failed to repoint symlink for node %q: %w", d.Cfg.ShortName, err)
1190: 		if _, restoreErr := parkingNode.RestoreTo(ctx, d); restoreErr != nil {
1191: 			// Keep the parking netns and its endpoints so a later restore can recover them.
1192: 			d.parkingNode = parkingNode
1193: 			return errors.Join(repointErr, restoreErr)
1194: 		}
1195: 		d.parkingNode = nil
1196: 		if cleanupErr := d.cleanupParkingNetNS(); cleanupErr != nil {
1197: 			return errors.Join(repointErr, cleanupErr)
1198: 		}
1199: 		return repointErr
1200: 	}
1201: 	d.parkingNode = parkingNode
1202: 
1203: 	return nil
1204: }
1205: 
1206: // RestoreEndpoints tries to get the parking node to unpark its interfaces.
1207: func (d *DefaultNode) RestoreEndpoints(ctx context.Context) error {
1208: 	parkPath, err := d.parkingNetNSPath()
1209: 	if err != nil {
1210: 		// No parking netns means the node had no parked interfaces - e.g. it was
1211: 		// stopped outside of containerlab (so its interfaces were never parked) or
1212: 		// it has no dataplane links. Nothing to restore.
1213: 		d.parkingNode = nil
1214: 		log.Debugf("node %q has no parking netns, nothing to restore", d.Cfg.ShortName)
1215: 		return nil
1216: 	}
1217: 	parkingNode := d.parkingNode
1218: 	if parkingNode == nil {
1219: 		parkingNode = clablinks.NewParkingNode(d.Cfg.LongName, parkPath)
1220: 	}
1221: 
1222: 	restored, err := parkingNode.RestoreTo(ctx, d)
1223: 	if err != nil {
1224: 		return err
1225: 	}
1226: 
1227: 	for _, ep := range restored {
1228: 		log.Info("Restored link", "node", d.Cfg.ShortName, "interface", ep.GetIfaceName())
1229: 	}
1230: 
1231: 	if err := d.cleanupParkingNetNS(); err != nil {
1232: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to cleanup parking netns for node %q: %w", d.Cfg.ShortName, err)
1233: 	}
1234: 	d.parkingNode = nil
1235: 
1236: 	return nil
1237: }

1239: func (d *DefaultNode) Stop(ctx context.Context) error {
1240: 	cfg := d.Config()
1241: 
1242: 	if d.ShouldSkipLifecycle() {
1243: 		log.Debugf("node %q skips lifecycle stop", cfg.ShortName)
1244: 		return nil
1245: 	}
1246: 
1247: 	status := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)
1248: 	switch status {
1249: 	case clabruntime.Stopped:
1250: 		log.Debugf("node %q already stopped, skipping", cfg.ShortName)
1251: 		return nil
1252: 	case clabruntime.NotFound:
1253: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q container %q not found", cfg.ShortName, cfg.LongName)
1254: 	}
1255: 
1256: 	if err := d.OverwriteNode.PreStop(ctx); err != nil {
1257: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q pre-stop hook failed: %w", cfg.ShortName, err)
1258: 	}
1259: 
1260: 	if err := d.ParkEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {
1261: 		return err
1262: 	}
1263: 
1264: 	if err := d.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, cfg.LongName, d.StopSignal); err != nil {
1265: 		// Docker/podman may return an error while the container is already stopped.
1266: 		// if ctr is already stopped, this is OK
1267: 		if d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.Stopped {
1268: 			log.Warnf(
1269: 				"node %q stop returned error but container is stopped: %v",
1270: 				cfg.ShortName,
1271: 				err,
1272: 			)
1273: 			return nil
1274: 		}
1275: 
1276: 		if restoreErr := d.RestoreEndpoints(ctx); restoreErr != nil {
1277: 			return errors.Join(
1278: 				fmt.Errorf("node %q failed stopping container: %w", cfg.ShortName, err),
1279: 				fmt.Errorf("failed to restore endpoints: %w", restoreErr),
1280: 			)
1281: 		}
1282: 
1283: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q failed stopping container: %w", cfg.ShortName, err)
1284: 	}
1285: 
1286: 	return nil
1287: }
1288: 
1289: // Start restarts a stopped container and restores its parked dataplane interfaces.
1290: func (d *DefaultNode) Start(ctx context.Context) error {
1291: 	cfg := d.Config()
1292: 
1293: 	if d.ShouldSkipLifecycle() {
1294: 		log.Debugf("node %q skips lifecycle start", cfg.ShortName)
1295: 		return nil
1296: 	}
1297: 
1298: 	status := d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)
1299: 
1300: 	switch status {
1301: 	case clabruntime.Running:
1302: 		log.Debugf("node %q already running, skipping", cfg.ShortName)
1303: 		return nil
1304: 	case clabruntime.NotFound:
1305: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q container %q not found", cfg.ShortName, cfg.LongName)
1306: 	}
1307: 
1308: 	if _, err := d.Runtime.StartContainer(ctx, cfg.LongName, d); err != nil {
1309: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q failed starting container: %w", cfg.ShortName, err)
1310: 	}
1311: 
1312: 	if err := d.RestoreEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {
1313: 		_ = d.Runtime.StopContainer(ctx, cfg.LongName, d.StopSignal)
1314: 		return err
1315: 	}
1316: 
1317: 	// Re-run topology exec commands on lifecycle start to restore node-local interface config
1318: 	// (for example IP addresses added during deploy exec phase).
1319: 	execCollection := clabexec.NewExecCollection()
1320: 	if err := d.RunExecFromConfig(ctx, execCollection); err != nil {
1321: 		log.Errorf(
1322: 			"failed to run exec commands for node %q on lifecycle start: %v",
1323: 			cfg.ShortName,
1324: 			err,
1325: 		)
1326: 	}
1327: 	execCollection.Log()
1328: 
1329: 	return nil
1330: }

d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerStatus(ctx)\n986: \t\tif !clabruntime.ContainerHasJoinableNetns(st) {\n987: \t\t\tif st == clabruntime.Stopped {\n988: \t\t\t\tcontainerName := clabutils.CreateOrGetNamedNetNS(d.parkingNetNSName())\n1171: \tif err != nil {\n1172: \t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to create parking netns for node %q: %w\", d.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n1173: \t}\n1174: \t\tparkingNode = clablinks.NewParkingNode(d.Cfg.LongName, parkPath)\n1179: \t}\n1180: \n1181: \tif err := parkingNode.CaptureFrom(ctx, d); err != nil {\n1182: \t\tif !reused {\n1183: \t\t\t_ = {\n\t\tnsp, err = d.Runtime.GetNSPath(ctx, d.OverwriteNode.GetContainerName())\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"Unable to determine NetNS Path for node %s: %v\", d.Cfg.ShortName, err)\n\t\t\treturn \"\", err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nsp, err\n}\n\n// ShouldSkipLifecycle reports whether lifecycle operations should no-op for this node.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) ShouldSkipLifecycle() inspect.Config.Labels[boxenImageVendorLabel] == boxenImageVendorValue\n}\n\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) ComputeDiff(oldCfg, newCfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig) *clabtypes.TopologyDiff {\n\tdiff := {\n\t\t\tif ifName == seenEp.GetIfaceName() {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%q and %q have overlapping interface names\", ep, seenEp)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tseenEps = append(seenEps, ep)\n\t}\n\n\treturn implement this method.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) CheckInterfaceName() error {\n\treturn d.CheckInterfaceOverlap()\n}\n\n// CalculateInterfaceIndex parses the supplied interface name with the InterfaceRegexp.\n// Using the the port offset, it calculates the mapped interface index based on the InterfaceOffset\n// and the first data interface index.\nfunc (d *DefaultNode) CalculateInterfaceIndex(ifName string) (int, error) {\n\tcaptureGroups, err := clabutils.GetRegexpCaptureGroups(d.InterfaceRegexp, ifName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0, err\n\t}\n\n\tif parsedIndex, found := captureGroups[\"port\"]; found {\n\t\tparsedIndexInt, err := strconv.Atoi(parsedIndex)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\"%q parsed index %q could not be cast to an integer\",\n\t\t\t\tifName,\n\t\t\t\tparsedIndex,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcalculatedIndex := parsedIndexInt - d.InterfaceOffset + d.FirstDataIfIndex\n\t\treturn calculatedIndex, nil\n\t} else {\n\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"%q does not have extracted interface index with regexp %q, 'port' capture group missing?\",\n\t\t\tifName,\n\t\t\td.InterfaceRegexp,\n\t\t)\n\t}\n}\n\n//
